Tara (sec-eng): Quick PSA: running a short 'lite entitlement sweep' Sat 05:30 UTC. scope: admin-like roles, KMS grants, and quick audit evidence. Non-destructive first pass (shadow only). Ibrahim (infra): I can run KMS grant discovery and tag keys with `last_decrypt`. Will filter grants >90d and principals with no api calls in 45d. Yuki (platform): I'll add a CI job that runs the report and creates a PR with a shadow list. Dry-run cmd: `./tools/ent-report --role=admin --days=90 --dry-run --format=csv` output -> s3://redwood-sec/lite/5400000000/ Tara (sec-eng): Add columns: principal, kind, last_api, last_token, shadow_until, kms_last_decrypt, evidence_link. Keep `shadow_until` = now+7d. oncall-bot: Maintenance window Sat 05:30-06:30 UTC. Suppressing non-actionable pages during window. Ibrahim (infra): I will also attach `key_policy_snapshots.tar.gz`. Tag principals with static creds in `flags`. Uploading dry-run CSV shortly. Yuki (platform): Post-shadow smoke checks: deploy-canary and secret-refresh. If any check fails mark principal `restore_candidate` and run `./scripts/restore_binding --principal

--ttl 2h`. I'll add the one-click restore link in the PR. Tara (sec-eng): Also do a tiny vuln check: if principal maps to image/agent older than 90d, tag `vuln_review` with CVE links. Don't remove for vuln-only. Ibrahim (infra): ACK. Will include `vuln_notes` column. Yuki (platform): I'll ensure artifacts are redacted (email/ip) before packaging for compliance. Tara (sec-eng): Great. Please ACK availability for Sat 05:30. Ibrahim (infra): ack Yuki (platform): ack :thumbsup: Tara (sec-eng): Thanks. We'll triage the dry-run in #eng-security 30m after run and only apply shadow moves after confirmation.
